[Command: #cUp + Attack Key#]
#cRight-click to lock command#

skills.skillEffectDescription: #c[Final Attack Skill]# Has a 40% chance to deal 150% additional damage.

skills.skillDescription:
[Master Level: 19]

Unlocks the true power of combos.
Combos automatically increase over time or when landing direct skill ATTacks.
Your ATT and Movement Speed increase each time your Combo Count stacks, and your Critical Rate and Knockback Resistance increase permanently.
Required Skills: #cSmash Swing Lv. 15#
#cLevel 19 required to learn Advanced Combo Ability, Adrenaline Rush, Adrenaline Rush Activate#
skills.skillEffectDescription:
Increase your Combo Count by the number of direct skill Attacks you land.
When your combo is at least 1, you'll obtain 20 combos every 5 seconds.
Your ATT increases by 2 and your Movement Speed increases by 3 for every 50 combo stacks.
The ATT and Movement Speed increase effect can stack up to 10 times. 
[Passive Effect: Critical Rate: +20%, Knockback Resistance: +50%]

skills.skillDescription:

Summon all of Aran's power to move like the divine Black Tortoise and sweep enemies away with Maha.\nRequired Skills: #cCombo Ability Lv. 1#\n#cLevel 20 required to learn Beyond Blade Mastery I#
skills.skillEffectDescription: MP Cost: 20, Max Enemies Hit: 6, Number of Attacks: 5, Damage: 115%\nCritical Hit Rate: +30%

skills.skillDescription:
[Master Level: 10]

Absorbs some of the damage you dealt to the enemies as HP.\nPermanently increases your Max HP.\nCan be toggled #cOn/Off#
skills.skillEffectDescription: MP Cost: 20, recovers 1% of Max HP when landing direct skill attacks.\n[Passive Effect: Max HP +10%]

skills.skillDescription:
[Master Level: 10]

Permanently increases damage and infuses your polearm with the powers of the ice spirit for a short time.\nCan be toggled #cOn/Off#
skills.skillEffectDescription: MP Cost: 20, Enemy Speed: -40 for 20 sec, Damage: +10% when landing direct skill attacks on enemies that have had their speed reduced.\n#cWhen used against bosses, the speed reduction effect and duration is cut in half.#\n[Passive Effect: Damage: +10%]

skills.skillDescription:
[Master Level: 1]

Unleash even more powerful combat abilities by becoming a true master of combos. Combo Ability will always apply its maximum effect.\nPermanently increases Attack Power, Abnormal Status Resistance, and Critical Damage.\nRequired Skill: #cCombo Ability Lv. 19#

skills.skillDescription:

Harness the experience of countless battlefields to push your battle prowess to the pinnacle of mortal ability.

Adrenaline Rush is not affected by buff duration increase effects.
Required Skills: #cCombo Ability Lv. 19#
#cLevel 20 required to learn Finisher - Hunter's Prey and Adrenaline Overload#
skills.skillEffectDescription: After reaching 1,000 combos, use Adrenaline Rush Activate to enter Adrenaline Rush for 15 seconds.\n#cIceflow#: Activates during Adrenaline Rush, attacks up to 7 enemies with 350% damage 2 times.

#cLevel 20 required to learn Beyond Blade Mastery II#

Activates Adrenaline Rush if you use the skill while Adrenaline Rush is available. Once Adrenaline Rush ends, your combos reset to 0.

After acquiring Adrenaline Overload, you can activate Adrenal Awakening by using the skill again when Adrenal Awakening is available.
Use the skill while pressing the Down arrow key to immediately activate Adrenal Awakening when it is available. With Action Customization enabled, you can immediately activate Adrenal Awakening without the arrow keys.
Required Skills: #cCombo Ability Lv. 19#
#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.#
skills.skillEffectDescription: Available upon reaching 1,000 combos.\nOnce Adrenaline Rush ends, you'll earn back combos based on the number of direct skill attacks landed while Adrenaline Rush was active.\nEarn back 30%, 60%, or 100% of 200 combos for every 8 attacks landed.

Harmonize the full power of Maha and your combos with the remembered thrill of a thousand battlefields, surpassing Adrenaline Rush.
Activates #cAdrenal Awakening#, allowing you to unleash Maha's full might by landing a certain number of attacks while Adrenaline Rush is active.
Adrenal Awakening enables #cHyper Finisher Skills# and allows you to deal additional damage to enemies by channeling Maha's power into a #cGolden Burst#.
Adrenal Awakening does not affect the duration of Adrenaline Rush.
Adrenal Awakening is not affected by Buff Duration increases.
Required Skills: #cAdrenaline Rush Lv. 20#
#c Must be level 30 or higher to learn Hyper Finisher - Last
Stand#

#cAdrenal Awakening#: lasts 5 seconds, enables Hyper Finisher skills, activates #cGolden Burst# every 1.2 seconds when using direct skill attacks.
#cGolden Burst#: Deals 650% Damage 10 times to up to 12 enemies.
Cooldown: 180 seconds, Adrenal Awakening cooldown displays via the border of Adrenaline Rush Activate

#cRight-click to lock command#

#cRight-click to toggle the ice shard effect ON/OFF#

Activates an aura for 30 sec after the attack, which periodically afflicts up to 5 enemies with the Dire Wolf's Curse.
Reusing the skill ends the it immediately
#cDire Wolf's Curse#: lasts 15 seconds, hitting afflicted enemies with direct skill attacks increases the duration up to 30 seconds, and #cice shards# appear for additional attacks. The curse can be stacked up to 6 times, increasing the ice shard attack count proportionally 1 times.
#cIce Chunks#: Max Enemies Hit: 15, Damage: 1200%, Number of Attacks: 4, Cooldown: 0.4 sec
Cooldown: 90 sec

#cRight-click to lock command#

Adrenaline Lv. 1#
